personality_one_liner: A rugged, tactical, and highly legible command center built for ultra-endurance tracking and live pace adjustments.

spacing.rule: Dense but scannable. Use sm/md spacing for data rows. Reserve lg spacing for section divisions. No decorative empty space.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and borders to separate sections instead of blur, maintaining high contrast for outdoor visibility.
dont's: Do not use glass/blur on this app. It reduces legibility in harsh outdoor lighting.

screens.name: Schedule
screens.purpose: Interactive arrival-time calculator and POI list.

states.loading: Skeleton rows reflecting the exact dimensions of the POI cards.
states.empty: No POIs match the selected filter. Show a reset filter button.
states.error: Failed to load spreadsheet data. Retry button prominent.

screens.layout:
1. Sticky Header (solid surfaceSecondary, bottom border): Top row has Start Time picker (left) and Pace input mm:ss (right). Use Barlow Condensed for the numeric values to make them feel like a digital watch interface.
2. Chip Row: Horizontally scrolling row of filter chips directly below the inputs (All, Food, Water, Church, etc.). Active state uses brandSecondary bg with brandPrimary text.
3. List: Flat list of POI cards. Each card uses a 3-column grid layout for fast scanning. Left: Distance (e.g. '42.5 km' in Barlow). Center: POI Name, Category icon, Off-route badge (if true, small error-tinted pill). Right: Arrival Time (e.g. '14:30' in Barlow Condensed). Dividers between rows, no card shadows.

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: Live GPS tracking overlaid on the Gotland route with next-POI awareness.

states.loading: Map loading state with center spinner.
states.error: GPS signal lost or location permissions denied banner.

screens.layout:
1. Full-screen react-native-maps view with a dark/night map style JSON.
2. Overlay Floating Panel: Pinned to the bottom (above the tab bar). A solid surfaceSecondary rounded-md rectangle. Displays a split view: Left shows Current Speed (large Barlow metric). Right shows 'Next: [POI Name]' and 'Distance to go'.
3. FAB: 'Recenter' icon button floating above the panel on the right side.

screens.name: About
screens.purpose: Contextual information regarding the Gotland 511 route.
screens.layout:
1. Hero Image: Full width, height ~250pt, featuring the Gotland landscape image. Requires a gradient-to-dark scrim (top-down transparent to surface) so the back button and header text are legible.
2. Content: Edge-to-edge typography layout with lg padding. Title 'Gotland 511' in Barlow Condensed xl. Standard DM Sans for body copy explaining the event and how the pace calculation works.

about_hero.alt: Church tower and lush fields on Gotland Island, Sweden.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 7 Dark-First Utility personality. Do not use glassmorphism or blur effects; rely on solid surfaceSecondary and borders for layering to maximize outdoor visibility.

Implement the POI card list as a dense, scannable data table. Use the condensed display font (Barlow Condensed) for all numbers (Time, Distance, Pace) to reinforce the athletic, Wahoo/Garmin-style command center feel.
Ensure the sticky header on the Schedule screen is anchored securely, with the list scrolling behind it, and that the filter chips remain accessible at all times.

For the Map screen, ensure the map style is forced into a dark/night theme to match the overall UI. The bottom floating panel must sit above the safe area / tab bar and remain easily legible with high contrast.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure all touch targets (especially the filter chips and map FAB) are at least 44x44pt.
The about hero image must have the mandatory top-down gradient scrim (transparent to surface) applied to ensure the back button and any overlaid text remain readable against the photo.
